content.content:
-- Clients feature: name + email, one row per client.
-- BY DEFAULT identity so the test seed can insert explicit ids (fixture ids), while normal
-- creates still auto-generate.
CREATE TABLE clients (
    id    BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    name  VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    email VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL
);
-- Invoices feature: an invoice belongs to a project and records a money amount.
-- BY DEFAULT identity so the test seed can insert explicit ids (fixture ids), while normal
-- creates still auto-generate. project_id is a required foreign key onto projects.
CREATE TABLE invoices (
    id         BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    project_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id),
    amount     DECIMAL(12, 2) NOT NULL
);
-- An invoice can carry a percentage discount taken off its subtotal (the sum of its line items).
-- The final total is the subtotal less that discount. Additive: a new column on the existing
-- invoices table. Existing invoices have no discount, so default to 0 (NOT NULL so the column
-- always has a value to compute with). Stored as a whole/fractional percent (e.g. 10 = 10%).
ALTER TABLE invoices ADD COLUMN discount_pct DECIMAL(5, 2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0;
-- An invoice can carry a percentage sales tax added ON TOP of its total, worked out AFTER the
-- discount: the taxable base is the subtotal less the discount, and the tax is that percentage of
-- it. The invoice's amount therefore becomes (subtotal - discount) plus that tax. Additive: a new
-- column on the existing invoices table. Existing invoices carry no tax, so default to 0 (NOT NULL
-- so the column always has a value to compute with). Stored as a whole/fractional percent
-- (e.g. 20 = 20%).
ALTER TABLE invoices ADD COLUMN tax_pct DECIMAL(5, 2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0;
-- Invoice line items: an invoice is now built from the things being charged for. Each line records
-- a description, a quantity, and the price of each — the invoice's amount is the sum of qty*price
-- across its lines. Additive: a new table alongside invoices, one row per line.
CREATE TABLE line_items (
    id          BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    invoice_id  BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES invoices(id),
    description VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    qty         INTEGER NOT NULL,
    unit_price  DECIMAL(12, 2) NOT NULL
);

-- The invoice amount is no longer a single figure the user types: it is derived from the line
-- items. Relax the stored amount column so an invoice can exist (and start empty, totalling zero)
-- without a typed amount — the running total is computed from its lines.
ALTER TABLE invoices DROP CONSTRAINT invoices_amount_positive;
ALTER TABLE invoices ALTER COLUMN amount SET NULL;
ALTER TABLE invoices ALTER COLUMN amount SET DEFAULT 0;
